Class 5A playoff preview: Bloomington in Opening Round
Bloomington hosts Marion in a Class 5A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Bloomington will win 28-27.
Bloomington hosts Marion in a Class 5A Opening Round game this weekend, and according to our projections, Bloomington will win 28-27.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 5A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Saturday, Oct. 24
- 3 p.m.: South: No. 17 Marion (4-5) at No. 16 Bloomington (4-5) (Bloomington 28, Marion 27)
Game Capsules
No. 17 Marion (4-5) at No. 16 Bloomington (4-5)
Marion travels to Bloomington in the Class 5A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 1 Mahomet-Seymour (9-0) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 3 p.m. Saturday.
#16 Bloomington (4-5)
Bloomington (4-5) is the No. 16 seed in the 48-team Class 5A field and hosts No. 17 Marion in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Bloomington went 4-5 overall and 4-4 in Big Twelve, scoring 221 points and allowing 243, an average margin of -2.4 a game.
Bloomington went 7-4 last season, including 1-1 in playoffs. Bloomington has reached the playoffs in four of the last 10 seasons.
